# Myco

> Myco is the nervous system for AI-assisted software teams. It captures what coding agents do, turns it into durable project knowledge, and hands that knowledge back to every agent and teammate on the project.

Myco 2.0 keeps a team's knowledge on a Deployment, a server the team runs on Cloudflare or on its own laptop or virtual machine. Each person's machine signs in with `myco login <invite link>`, `myco member provision <agent>` connects their coding agents, and those agents capture sessions to the Deployment and read from it through MCP. Myco's own agent runs on a worker on an administrator's machine. It titles sessions, writes and curates spores (decisions, gotchas, discoveries, trade-offs, fixes), seeds a project from its code and history, and keeps a map of the repository. Everything is configured on the Deployment's dashboard.

macOS and Linux are supported. The Windows installer still installs Myco 1.4.

## Start here

- [Homepage](https://myco.sh/): Product overview and install command.
- [Quickstart](https://myco.sh/quickstart.md): Set up a Deployment, invite people, connect a machine and its agents, and the known gaps in today's flow.
- [Upgrading from 1.4](https://myco.sh/upgrade-from-v1.md): Move a Myco 1.4 machine to 2.0 with `myco cutover`, and what it keeps.
- [Self-hosting](https://myco.sh/self-hosting.md): Run a Deployment on a laptop, a virtual machine or Cloudflare; updates and backups.

## Using Myco

- [How Myco learns](https://myco.sh/intelligence.md): What Myco produces from captured sessions, where that work runs, and what agents get back.
- [Agents](https://myco.sh/agents.md): The agents Myco captures, how to connect them, and what is captured.
- [Agent tools](https://myco.sh/agent-tools.md): The MCP tools agents use to search and curate a project's knowledge.
- [External agents](https://myco.sh/external-agents.md): Access keys for agents that are not members, such as hosted code reviewers.
- [Configuration](https://myco.sh/configuration.md): Deployment settings, per-project capabilities, machine settings, sandboxes and CI.
- [Troubleshooting](https://myco.sh/troubleshooting.md): The messages people meet most and what to do about each.

## Optional

- [Install script for macOS and Linux](https://myco.sh/install.sh): The Myco 2.0 shell installer.
- [Myco 2.0 architecture](https://github.com/goondocks-co/myco/blob/main/docs/architecture/myco-2.0.md): How the Deployment, members, workers and capture fit together.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/goondocks-co/myco): Source code, issues and releases.
